description: Metadata for confirmed public pages of the University of Cambridge Centre for the Study of Existential Risk on www.cser.ac.uk. Each URL was confirmed with one bounded GET. Rows store a title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights label. Page text is not stored. Rights is creative_commons only for CC0, CC BY, or CC BY-SA, and uk_ogl only when the page states the Open Government Licence. Otherwise rights is unknown. A copyright notice is not a licence. This centre is not a UK government publisher. A missing publication date stays unknown. News posts and individual team profiles are not listed. This catalog is not a belief collector.
